Container.Name: binhex-filebrowser-quantum
Container.Overview: File Browser provides a file managing interface within a specified directory and it can be used to upload, delete, preview and edit your files. It is a create-your-own-cloud-kind of software where you can just install it on your server, direct it to a path and access your files through a nice web interface.
Container.Requires:
**Default authentication** Username: admin Password: filebrowser-quantum
**Important**: Please ensure you change the default password after first login, you can do this through the web interface.
Container.DonateText: If you appreciate my work, then please consider buying me a beer :D

Config.Name: Port: Web Interface
Config.Description: This is the Web UI port for the application.

Config.Name: Path: /config
Config.Description: This is the container path to your configuration files, e.g. databases, configuration files, logs etc.

Config.Name: Path: /media
Config.Description: This is the container path to your media files, e.g. movies, tv, music, pictures etc.

Config.Name: Variable: FILEBROWSER_ADMIN_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Admin password. Leave blank to keep the upstream behaviour: a random admin password is generated, written to the container log once, and a reset is forced at first login.

Config.Name: Variable: FILEBROWSER_JWT_TOKEN_SECRET
Config.Description: Secret used to sign JWT authentication tokens. Changing it after first start invalidates all existing sessions.

Config.Name: Variable: FILEBROWSER_TOTP_SECRET
Config.Description: Encryption secret for stored TOTP two-factor secrets. Set it before enrolling users in TOTP.

Config.Name: Variable: FILEBROWSER_RECAPTCHA_SECRET
Config.Description: reCAPTCHA secret key used by password authentication when reCAPTCHA is enabled in config.yaml.

Config.Name: Variable: FILEBROWSER_LDAP_USER_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Password of the LDAP bind account used to look up users.

Config.Name: Variable: FILEBROWSER_OIDC_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: OIDC client id for single sign-on, for example from Authentik, Keycloak or Pocket ID.

Config.Name: Variable: FILEBROWSER_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET
Config.Description: OIDC client secret for single sign-on.

Config.Name: Variable: FILEBROWSER_ONLYOFFICE_SECRET
Config.Description: JWT secret shared with your OnlyOffice document server.

Config.Name: Variable: FILEBROWSER_DISABLE_AUTOMATIC_BACKUP
Config.Description: Automatic backups are on by default. Set this to true to disable the backup taken automatically before an upgrade.

Config.Name: Variable: FILEBROWSER_CONFIG
Config.Description: Path to the configuration file.

Config.Name: Variable: FILEBROWSER_DATABASE_PATH
Config.Description: Path to the SQLite database.

Config.Name: Variable: FILEBROWSER_FFMPEG_PATH
Config.Description: Directory holding the ffmpeg and ffprobe binaries.

Config.Name: Variable: ADDITIONAL_PARAMETERS
Config.Description: Additional parameters to pass to the File Browser cli

Config.Name: Variable: ENABLE_HEALTHCHECK
Config.Description: Enable or disable healthchecks.

Config.Name: Variable: HEALTHCHECK_COMMAND
Config.Description: The command or script to execute, if not specified then the script healthcheck.sh will be used (process, dns and https checking).

Config.Name: Variable: HEALTHCHECK_ACTION
Config.Description: The action to execute if the healthcheck command returns a non zero exit code, if not specified the action will be 'exit 1', if you want the container to exit on failure then set the action to 'kill 1'.

Config.Name: Variable: HEALTHCHECK_HOSTNAME
Config.Description: The hostname used when performing HTTPS and DNS healthchecking.

Config.Name: Variable: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for the running container

Config.Name: Variable: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for the running container

Config.Name: Variable: UMASK
Config.Description: UMASK for the running container
